label: Nút thêm tương phản
pattern: IconButton\.filled\(\s*key: const ValueKey\(\'mobile-catalog-create\'\),\s*tooltip: \'Thêm sản phẩm\',\s*onPressed: c\.busy \? null : \(\) => editProduct\(context\),\s*icon: const Icon\(Icons\.add\),\s*\)
replacement:
IconButton(
                    key: const ValueKey('mobile-catalog-create'),
                    tooltip: 'Thêm sản phẩm',
                    onPressed: c.busy ? null : () => editProduct(context),
                    style: IconButton.styleFrom(
                      backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFE7F1FF),
                      foregroundColor: const Color(0xFF0759BB),
                      disabledBackgroundColor: const Color(0xFFF1F5F9),
                      side: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFFBCD8FC)),
                    ),
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.add, size: 25),
                  )

label: Lọc dễ nhìn
pattern: IconButton\.outlined\(\s*tooltip: \'Lọc danh mục, quy cách, trạng thái\',\s*onPressed: \(\) => _filters\(context, c\),\s*icon: const Icon\(Icons\.tune\),\s*\)
replacement:
IconButton(
                    tooltip: 'Lọc danh mục, quy cách, trạng thái',
                    onPressed: () => _filters(context, c),
                    style: IconButton.styleFrom(
                      backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFF0F3F8),
                      foregroundColor: const Color(0xFF344760),
                      side: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFFCBD5E1)),
                    ),
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.tune, size: 23),
                  )

label: Nút nhập kho rõ tương phản
pattern: TextButton\.icon\(\s*onPressed: shop\.busy\s*\? null\s*:\s*\(\) => receiveStock\(context, p\),\s*icon: const Icon\(Icons\.add_box_outlined, size: 17\),\s*label: const Text\(\'Nhập kho\'\),\s*style: TextButton\.styleFrom\(\s*visualDensity: VisualDensity\.compact,\s*padding: const EdgeInsets\.symmetric\(horizontal: 6\),\s*\),\s*\)
replacement:
OutlinedButton.icon(
                    onPressed: shop.busy ? null : () => receiveStock(context, p),
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.add_box_outlined, size: 19),
                    label: const Text('Nhập kho'),
                    style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                      foregroundColor: const Color(0xFF0759BB),
                      backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFF0F7FF),
                      side: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFFC0D9F8)),
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 8),
                      visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                    ),
                  )

label: Menu xóa khách có icon
pattern: PopupMenuItem<String>\(value: 'delete', enabled: !c\.busy,\s*child: const Text\('Xóa khách hàng'\)\)
replacement:
PopupMenuItem<String>(
                        value: 'delete',
                        enabled: !c.busy,
                        child: const Row(children: [
                          Icon(Icons.delete_outline, size: 19, color: Color(0xFFDC2626)),
                          SizedBox(width: 10),
                          Text('Xóa'),
                        ]),
                      )

label: Thêm khách gọn trên mobile
pattern: FilledButton\.icon\(\s*onPressed: \(\) => editCustomer\(context\),\s*icon: const Icon\(Icons\.add, size: 18\),\s*label: const Text\('Thêm khách hàng'\),\s*\)
replacement:
if (MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).width < 600)
                  IconButton(
                    tooltip: 'Thêm khách hàng',
                    onPressed: () => editCustomer(context),
                    style: IconButton.styleFrom(
                      backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFE7F1FF),
                      foregroundColor: const Color(0xFF0759BB),
                      side: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFFBCD8FC)),
                    ),
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.person_add_alt_1_outlined),
                  )
                else
                  FilledButton.icon(
                    onPressed: () => editCustomer(context),
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.add, size: 18),
                    label: const Text('Thêm khách hàng'),
                  )
